title: Append-only corrections for recorded transition reasons and archived session next_action (#167)
description: Append-only corrections for recorded transition reasons and archived session next_action (#167)
acceptance_criteria: An agent can append a correction that names a recorded history event or an archived session's next_action, carrying who recorded it, why, and the corrected statement, without rewriting the original event; history show, next, status and the archived session's readers surface the correction beside what it corrects; the original bytes and event digests are unchanged.
